brief.headline: AEGIS full overhaul — force-on-force battle simulation, military model library (armour/artillery/rotary/infantry), detailed houses, and a latent geometry-merge bug fixed across every model.

items.text: AEGIS battle sim: BATTLE button deploys two 24-unit combined-arms forces (Abrams, Bradley, Stryker, Humvee, Paladin, HIMARS, Apache, rifle squads) that acquire, close and engage on published effective ranges. Belt-fed weapons fire 6-9 round bursts and pause; rifles are aimed semi-auto. Armour is checked against each weapon's AP value. Faction rings, tracers, muzzle flashes, live force-strength HUD.

AEGIS military models authored in real metres with one conversion, so soldier/Humvee/Abrams proportions are correct by construction. Includes sloped Abrams glacis and 5.3m gun, Bradley TOW box, M109 fume extractor, Stryker 2+2 axle grouping and slat armour, Apache tandem cockpit. Infantry in standing/kneeling/prone with helmet, plate carrier, ruck and rifle. Houses gained gable roofs, doors, window bays and chimneys.

Fixed a latent bug that had been silently deleting model detail project-wide: mergeParts sized its buffers from the INDEXED vertex count before de-indexing, so overflow writes were swallowed and trailing parts vanished. The Stryker and Humvee were losing their entire hulls. Vertex counts roughly doubled after the fix.

AEGIS worldwide: 51 destinations across all 7 regions, each built from real coordinates and a real ETOPO1 elevation grid fetched at build time and baked in, so it still runs air-gapped. Searchable theater console (G) loads any site in ~2s.

AEGIS city identity: 8 street-grid archetypes with real bearings (Manhattan 29 deg, Barcelona 45 deg) and the empirical GHSL height gradient, so Paris reads as a 22m cap, Hong Kong a 96m wall and Dubai an 11m villa carpet with an 828m needle.

AEGIS graphics: vehicles rebuilt from true extruded side profiles (sloped hood, raked windshield, wheels with rims, lamps) in 4 types, humanoid pedestrians, antlered wildlife, window-textured buildings — all instanced. Added pooled rigid-body debris (glass, concrete, metal, embers) and a WASD sandbox mode.

AEGIS bugs fixed this round: city fabric filling from a map corner instead of the core, water buried under terrain, buildings inheriting per-site terrain exaggeration (which inverted Paris vs Dubai), toolbar overflow hiding RESET on phones, and salvo log flooding.

AEGIS: added multi-strike salvos (up to 4 aim points, staggered, per-target BDA), a Pathfinder Team Ops panel (MOVE/HOLD/SWEEP/EXFIL with tap-to-move waypoints), a casualty model with distinct civilian vs. animal silhouettes, a destructible State Capitol, SUNDOWN full-theater leveling, and a RESET button.
